gen-gf-unica-one-gf-aldrich: Aldrich stands tall, its x-height nearly touching the capitals and its rounds cupped open, under the commanding Unica One. That shared thick-thread stroke is what ties the two together.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-alexandria: Distinctive and poured-looking, Unica One holds every stroke at one width, with visible daylight inside each curve. Alexandria follows, wide-mouthed and tall-bodied, giving the whole page room to breathe.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-amiko: Uniform bars on top, sturdy lowercase below. Unica One ends every stroke at a measured width, while Amiko's lowercase stands crayon-tall and its terminals flare outward like tongs.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anek-bangla: Approachable lettering lives in Anek Bangla, with wide s curves barely curled in and a short climb from midline to ascender. Above it, Unica One's monoweight stroke gives the heading a firm voice.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anek-gujarati: Unica One hits hardest with commanding, unit-width strokes around an oversized lowercase eye. Anek Gujarati does the quieter work, its lowercase rivaling the capitals and its c gaping open.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anek-gurmukhi: Anek Gurmukhi gives every small letter a generous counter, with open-handed curves on each round character. Anek Gurmukhi feels loose-limbed beside Unica One, whose bars march across the line at identical thickness.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anek-kannada: Anek Kannada stands high like squared-off woodblock type, its terminals stopping well short of the stem. Unica One above matches that bluntness, every diagonal as stout as every upright.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anek-latin: Unica One gives its crossbars the full weight of its stems, a commanding stamped look. But Anek Latin lets its lowercase climb nearly to the capitals, letters held open rather than curled shut.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anek-malayalam: Anek Malayalam keeps a minimal gap between lowercase and capitals, its curve tips stopping short of touching. And with Unica One's unvarying weight above, paragraphs would settle into an unhurried, clean rhythm.
gen-gf-unica-one-gf-anek-odia: Anek Odia keeps its rounds unsealed, like an unlatched hook, and holds its capitals only slightly above the lowercase. While Unica One excels at loud, thinning-free curves, Anek Odia is built for quiet reading.
